facts.fact: 舞会前夜携 Maple 穿闹市，皮包藏龙。
facts.anchor: My gaze drifts to the heavy leather pack slung over my shoulder, concealing a very small, very illegal dragon.

facts.fact: Lucan 低声稳住包中 Maple。
facts.anchor: “Hush, little one. You have to stay out of sight.”

facts.fact: 进铁匠铺锁门，放 Maple 上楼。
facts.anchor: I lock the door behind us before turning toward Micah.

facts.fact: Maple 在公寓探索、扑飞撞吊灯。
facts.anchor: Her tiny talons click against the hardwood as she scans her new surroundings.

facts.fact: Lucan 铺报纸教定点如厕。
facts.anchor: “This is where you go potty. Do you understand?”

facts.fact: Micah 望窗外舞会筹备出神、情绪低落。
facts.anchor: Through the glass, the preparations for tomorrow’s ball are unfolding.

facts.fact: Lucan 邀其同赴王室舞会。
facts.anchor: “Micah,” I say softly. “Will you go to the ball with me?”

facts.fact: 打消 Micah 对安全的疑虑。
facts.anchor: We can’t let the king ruin this for us.

facts.fact: Micah 主动留宿；Lucan 抱人进卧室，本章收束。
facts.anchor: “Can I—” He swallows. “Can I stay the night?”
